pollIntervalSec.description: 轮询间隔（秒），最小 60，实际会加 0–20% 随机抖动

en.description: Polling interval in seconds, at least 60; adds 0–20% random jitter.

sendMode.description: 出站模式：review=AI 回复只进草稿队列，master 在 Console 或用 juejin-draft send <id> 审批后才发出（默认）；off=禁止出站。不提供自动直发

en.description: Outbound mode: review (default) queues AI replies as drafts; a master approves each send on the Console page or with juejin-draft send. off disables outbound messages. Automatic direct replies are not supported.

minSendIntervalSec.description: 审批后两次真实发送的最小间隔（秒），最小 10；不足时拒绝发送，不排队

en.description: Minimum interval between approved sends in seconds (at least 10). Sending too soon is rejected, not queued.

dataDir.description: 本地数据目录：待审草稿存在 <dataDir>/<endpoint id>/drafts.json（权限 600，相对进程工作目录），重启不丢。不要放进仓库

en.description: Local data directory. Pending drafts are stored in <dataDir>/<endpoint id>/drafts.json (mode 600, relative to the working directory) and survive restarts. Keep it out of the repository.

notify.description: 有新草稿或登录失效时，主动发消息提醒到这个聊天会话（通常是你和机器人的私聊）。不填则只在 Console「掘金评论审批」页和日志里看到

en.description: Chat conversation to notify when a new draft arrives or the login expires (usually your private chat with the bot). Without it, drafts only appear on the Console Juejin comment review page and in logs.
Adapter name, such as icqq or telegram.
Endpoint id of that adapter.
Conversation type.

en.description: Conversation id: your account for a private chat, or the group id.

articles.description: 白名单文章：文章 id（请写成带引号的字符串）或 https://juejin.cn/post/<id> 链接。只轮询这些文章的评论，不做全站搜索；留空 = 不轮询

en.description: Command prefix. The default empty string allows unprefixed commands; '/' requires a leading slash. Each endpoints[i] can override it.
